question:
Select the appropriate antonym for the underlined word.

The pillar of light has __faded.__
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'** i.e.' grown**'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined word is **'faded'** (मुरझाया), which means to have lost brightness or vividness.
 
• The correct antonym is** 'grown'** (बढ़ा), which refers to something that has increased or developed, and therefore the opposite of **'faded.'**

Therefore, the **correct answer** is-** 'grown'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Painted **(चित्रित) - Covered or decorated with paint.
 
• **Vanished **(गायब हो जाना) - Disappeared suddenly and completely.
 
• **Melted **(पिघल जाना) - Become liquefied by heating.
